title: Historian Hysteria
description: Compare two lists of location IDs by distance and similarity score.
writeup:
## Approach

Parse two columns of numbers into separate lists.

## Part 1

Sort both lists and pair them up element-by-element. The answer is the sum of absolute differences between each pair. Sorting ensures we match the smallest with the smallest, minimising total distance.

## Part 2

Compute a similarity score: for each number in the left list, multiply it by how many times it appears in the right list. A `Counter` on the right list gives O(1) lookups, making this efficient even for large inputs.
